notes: D1 is an acknowledged anchor gap: a live competitive contest among ~22 identifiable participants fits none of the five levels cleanly; public_collective is the least-wrong match and the manipulation risk is carried by D5. Candidate anchor fix logged for v1.1.

D1.evidenceQuote: the final result of the Matchday 8 fixture between Club Alpha and Club Bravo
D1.reasoning: The outcome is produced by a live competitive contest among many participants; no single party is entitled to decide it.

D2.evidenceQuote: recorded as the winner at the final whistle
D2.reasoning: The result is produced live in public; there is no early-knowledge window.

D3.evidenceQuote: the official match result published by the Continental Premier League
D3.reasoning: No early-knowledge window exists (D2 level 1), so there is no insider to constrain; a fixed match is a manufactured outcome, which D5 carries.

D4.evidenceQuote: scheduled to kick off at 15:00 local time on October 4, 2026
D4.reasoning: The outcome unfolds at a fixed, pre-announced time in front of everyone simultaneously.

D5.evidenceQuote: the full 90 minutes plus stoppage time
D5.reasoning: Manufacturing the result (match-fixing) requires coordination among players or officials.
